description: This PHP class implements a value formatter within the OrangeHRM system, specifically formatting pay period values with a fallback to 'No Pay Grade Details' if the value is absent.

classes.name: FormatWithPayPeriod
classes.description: A class implementing the ValueFormatter interface to provide pay period formatting with a default message for missing values.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the provided entity value if it exists; otherwise, returns a default string indicating no pay grade details.
